create_dataset: create a TensorFlow dataset for a CLRS algorithm split with batching and preprocessing
create_chunked_dataset: create a chunked dataset from CLRS full-trajectory samples with fixed time-length chunks
chunkify: chunk full-trajectory CLRS samples into fixed-length segments with start and end markers
CLRSDataset_info: build the dataset info schema for a CLRS algorithm by generating a single sample
get_dataset_gcp_url: get the GCP storage URL for downloading the CLRS30 dataset archive
